title: d-q Voltage Limiter
text: Limit voltage in the rotor direct-quadrature reference frame, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Axis prioritization} sets Prioritize the d - or q axis; {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the sampling interval. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Axis prioritization
params.values: Prioritize the d - or q axis Q-axis (default) | D-axis | D-Q equivalence

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Sampling interval -1 (default) | default value or a positive number
